body.condition: For every \(n\ge1\), \(r\in\mathcal R\), and \(1\le i\le n_r\), \(Y_{ri}^{\mathrm{obs}}=Y_{ri}(1)\) \(P_{r,n}^{\star}\)-almost surely when \(r\in\mathcal T\) and \(Y_{ri}^{\mathrm{obs}}=Y_{ri}(0)\) \(P_{r,n}^{\star}\)-almost surely when \(r\in\mathcal R\setminus\mathcal T\).

standard.name: SUTVA consistency for observed treatment histories
